mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a full moon overhead.

The City of Verona has issued a scam alert regarding fake planning application fee requests, reminding residents to pay only by check to City Hall, and fall leaf collection officially begins this October 5.
We have plenty to look forward to, including the Verona Fall Fest happening today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow at the Capitol Square.
In a weekly update, officers reported that on September 10, a man was arrested for burglary after an incident involving a gunshot and a broken window at a local residence.
Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, and you can come by to enjoy today's flavor, z.
